questions.stem: Which picture best represents the addition of 5 circles and 3 squares?

choices.A: [Picture of a shape with 8 small shapes inside]
choices.B: [Picture of a shape with 7 small shapes inside]
choices.C: [Picture of a shape with 5 small shapes inside]
choices.D: [Picture of a shape with 3 small shapes inside]

questions.solution: The correct representation is A, as it shows 5 circles added to 3 squares, resulting in a total of 8 shapes.
questions.explanation: Adding 5 and 3 together gives us 8. The picture with 8 small shapes inside represents this addition accurately.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing B, as some might misinterpret it as adding the number of sides (7) instead of counting the individual small shapes.

questions.stem: Which picture best illustrates the sum of 4 circles and 6 squares?
questions.solution: The correct representation is C, as it shows 4 circles added to 6 squares, resulting in a total of 10 shapes.
questions.explanation: Adding the number of circles (4) and squares (6) gives us a total of 10 shapes. The picture with 4 circles and 6 squares accurately represents this addition.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A, as some might accidentally add the wrong quantities or not recognize that both circles and squares are being added.
